title: ESSENTIAL PROPERTIES REALTY TRUST, INC. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Essential Properties Realty Trust, Inc. filed a Form 8-K with the SEC on April 22, 2026, announcing Q1 2026 financial results for the period ending March 31, 2026. The filing includes an earnings press release (Exhibit 99.1) and Investor Presentation/Supplemental Information (Exhibit 99.2) as Regulation FD disclosures. This is a routine corporate earnings announcement and does not contain market structure or macro catalyst information.
